about:
Newfab Inc., headquartered in Auburn, Maine, traces its roots to 1955 when Northeast Welding and Fabrication was founded. The business started by producing wood stoves, concrete forms, railings, mounting brackets, and a variety of subcomponents for local customers.

Today the company operates as a full-service metal fabrication shop and contract manufacturer. Its capabilities span forming and welding, precision machining, painting and finishing, custom tooling and fixtures, product assemblies, turnkey equipment, and quality control and testing. Core product lines include high-temperature expansion joints and dampers, radio frequency transmission systems, machinery, and other custom metal assemblies, with engineering services supporting each project.

Newfab serves customers in energy, environmental, chemical, agricultural, alternative energy, military and defense, telecommunications, and industrial sectors. Its expansion joints and dampers are used in energy and environmental applications worldwide, while radio frequency transmission systems serve telecommunications clients, and custom machinery supports industrial and defense programs.

The company emphasizes proprietary manufacturing processes, specialized machinery, and dedicated tooling developed in-house to enable precise, efficient fabrication of complex components. It cites a commitment to quality, robustness, and on-time delivery, backed by decades of manufacturing heritage and a focus on rapid project turnaround.
